answer: In an AI-agent economy, sybil resistance arises by requiring every participant to embed a unique cryptographic relic along a shared activity ridge, where the relic is cultivated from a juniper seed of scarce stake or compute that is permanently burned at registration. An attacker must expend the full cultivation cost for each additional fake identity; as the ridge steepens with legitimate demand the per-identity price climbs, quickly exhausting the attacker’s resources while honest agents face only a single one-time cost.
